segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks for calling support, this is Alex. Can I get your company name and the last four of the invoice number?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, it’s Northline Parts, and the invoice ends in 4482. I’m calling about removing seats before our March renewal.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Got it. I have Northline Parts pulled up in the billing tool. You’re currently at 84 seats, renewal date March 15, and invoice 4482 is for $7,140. Are you looking to reduce the seat count for the next term?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Exactly. We only need 72 seats now. The issue is Jordan told me unused seats are credited automatically on the next invoice, but Maya emailed this morning saying credits only happen if we remove them before the renewal date. Those can’t both be right, so I need a straight answer before I approve anything.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yeah, understood. Let me check the account note and the policy in the knowledge base so I’m not guessing here. One moment.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Okay, thanks for waiting. The correct policy is: seat reductions take effect at the next renewal if requested before the renewal date. We do not issue an automatic mid-term credit for unused seats. So if we set you to 72 seats now, your March 15 renewal will bill at 72 seats.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: All right. So Maya’s version was the accurate one, and Jordan was wrong about the automatic credit?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yes, that’s correct. I’ll add a note on the ticket so there’s no ambiguity, and I can process the reduction to 72 seats effective March 15 if you want.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Please do. And send me confirmation with the new estimated renewal amount.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Done. I updated the admin console and the ticketing system. Your new renewal estimate is $6,120 for 72 seats, before any taxes. You’ll get the confirmation email in a few minutes under ticket 318746.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Got it. Thanks for clearing that up.
